jobs.title: Senior VA Full-Stack Application Modernization Consultant
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Proactive Logic Consulting INC is a boutique technology consulting firm specializing in innovation, assessments and roadmaps, process automation and AI, cloud modernization, and application modernization.

We bring together senior independent consultants who combine deep technical judgment, high EQ, a customer\-obsessed mindset, and an entrepreneurial approach to delivery.

Opportunity Context

We are building a vetted consulting bench for anticipated federal\-health and Veteran\-serving digital modernization engagements. This is a future or contingent consulting opportunity. It is not federal employment and does not imply that Proactive Logic currently holds a Department of Veterans Affairs award. Engagement timing depends on client demand and contracting approvals.

What We're Looking For

We are seeking a Senior VA Full\-Stack Application Modernization Consultant who has delivered production software within VA or VHA and can modernize Veteran\-facing and internal health applications without losing sight of accessibility, security, operational reliability, or mission outcomes.

This is a remote, 1099 Corp\-to\-Corp opportunity for a senior independent consultant. The strongest candidates can lead discovery, make sound architectural tradeoffs, write and review production code, and communicate clearly with program, security, clinical, accessibility, and engineering stakeholders.

Key Requirements

VA and Federal\-Health Delivery

\- At least 2 years of hands\-on production delivery within VA or VHA.

\- Practical experience with several relevant VA capabilities, such as VA Lighthouse APIs, Patient Health or benefits APIs, FHIR or SMART on FHIR, VistA or CPRS, Oracle Health or Cerner, SSOe or SSOi, PIV or CAC, or VA enterprise integration patterns.

\- Familiarity with VA Technical Reference Model alignment and federal delivery controls.

Senior Application Modernization

\- At least 10 years of software engineering and application delivery.

jobs.description:
**The application window is expected to close on:** 09/25/2026Job posting may be removed earlier if the position is filled or if a sufficient number of applications are received.
  
  

This position is fully remote and can be performed from any location within the United States. This role requires reliable internet connection and the ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  
  

Meet the Team
  
  

You’ll be joining Developer Acceleration, a team passionate about making it easier and faster for engineers across the organization to build test infrastructure and ship phenomenal software.
  
  

We lead the C\+\+/Python testing frameworks, developer tooling, CI/CD infrastructure, and quality platforms that product teams rely on every day. That gives our work significant leverage—when we make something faster, simpler, or more reliable, the impact is felt across the entire engineering organization.
  
  

You’ll work alongside engineers with deep expertise in build systems, cloud and Kubernetes infrastructure, and test infrastructure. You’ll have real ownership, plenty of autonomy, and a significant voice in shaping technical direction. We value thoughtful technical discussions, strong engineering practices, partnership, and building tools that developers genuinely enjoy using.
  
  

**There’s a lot of significant work ahead:** evolving our testing ecosystem, reducing flaky tests and CI times, and building the next generation of developer infrastructure. It’s a great opportunity to solve sophisticated technical problems while making engineers across the organization more productive. We couldn't be more excited about what's ahead, and we'd love for you to help us build it!
